input.summary: The repository contains several critical and high-severity DevOps and security violations, primarily within its GitHub Actions workflows. Key issues include hardcoded credentials in setup.yml, multiple command injection vulnerabilities via untrusted user input (PR titles and manual dispatch inputs) in greet-pr.yml and manual-deploy.yml, and a risky pull_request_target configuration in auto-label.yml that checks out untrusted code. Additionally, all workflows lack a permissions block, violating the principle of least privilege. From a project hygiene and quality perspective, the repository is missing a .gitignore file, has no linter or formatter configured, lacks actual tests (using dummy echo scripts instead), and the CI pipeline fails to validate the build despite a build script being defined in package.json.
